audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits the 50.7% win rate over 6718 games: Hwei owns levels 1-2 with longer-range paint poke, the middle is a cooldown-respect skill fight, and two-item Viktor out-scales his front-loaded combos.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text used the fabricated Viktor names 'Death Ray' (E) and 'Chaos Storm' (R), and mislabeled Hwei combos: 'QQ (Fleeting Current)' (QQ is Devastating Fire; Fleeting Current is WQ), 'EE (Stirring Lands)' (WE is Stirring Lights; the E-palette root is EW Gaze of the Abyss), 'QQ (Severing Bolt)' (Severing Bolt is QW), 'EQ (Devastating Fire)' (Devastating Fire is QQ).
audit.why: Kit files: Viktor E = Hextech Ray, R = Arcane Storm. Hwei's palettes per Riot: Q Subject: Disaster (QQ Devastating Fire, QW Severing Bolt, QE Molten Fissure), W Subject: Serenity (WQ Fleeting Current, WW Pool of Reflection, WE Stirring Lights), E Subject: Torment (EQ Grim Visage fear, EW Gaze of the Abyss root, EE Crushing Maw).
audit.corrected: All spike, why, mid and wants strings re-labeled with the real names; spike windows (E at 3, both ults at 6, first Hex Core item, two-item inversion) kept.
sources: League Wiki knowledge of Hwei subject names

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked ability was the fabricated 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' across winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus, cooldowns, feeding, do's and five report entries; the real CC palette is Subject: Torment (E, 12s rank 1). The Q-shield's role against his two-hit passive (Signature of the Visionary detonates on the second spell) was never stated.
audit.why: Kit: Hwei E 'Subject: Torment' 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, hardCC; P primes on first spell, completes on second. Viktor Q grants a shield — timed on the second paint it eats the signature completion.
audit.corrected: Fabricated name replaced everywhere edited; Q-shield-vs-passive interaction now in dosFull[1].d; cooldowns field carries 12s/18s/17s.

audit.why: It is the field that must hold real numbers.
audit.corrected: Now carries Subject: Torment 12s, Subject: Serenity 18s, Gravity Field 17s.

edits.before: Break even loudly, scale quietly, and own every fight from two items on. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.
edits.after: Break even loudly, scale quietly, and own every fight from two items on. Track Subject: Torment (his CC palette) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Torment CC — fear, root, or maw — then dumping his paint rotation before you can answer.

edits.before: - Viktor vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Aim the laser through minions into his chest — every E should farm AND poke. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.
edits.after: - Viktor vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (CC palette). - Aim the laser through minions into his chest — every E should farm AND poke. - Engage only on Subject: Torment’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.

edits.before: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints)
edits.after: Hwei Subject: Torment (CC)

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Gravity Field has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Hwei Subject: Torment: 12s at rank 1 — every fear, root and maw lives on that palette; dodge its opening cast and the burst never chains. Count it out loud if you must. - His Subject: Serenity shield palette is 18s. - Your Gravity Field is 17s: the moment it goes wrong; the R: the moment it goes right.

edits.before: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Fear (CC Paints) and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with E clears and stay relevant through W zone control.
edits.after: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Torment's CC range and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with E clears and stay relevant through W zone control.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Cast Siphon Power as his second paint flies — the shield eats the hit that would complete his passive signature detonation.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Hwei wastes Subject: Torment on the wave — that is your full-commit window.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: His waveclear keeps pace from far longer range than yours — you lose more tempo chasing plays than lasering the next wave.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment: all his fear, root and maw CC lives on that 12s palette — dodge the opener and the burst never chains. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your Luden's spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment’s 12s cooldown, on your Luden's spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Hwei

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: His paint poke out-ranges your 600-range Q — take Q-shield trades only in his cooldown gaps and give up contested CS.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Hwei

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: Still his: double-cast chip stacks his passive detonation on you while your laser barely reaches him at 525.

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: Arcane Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.

edits.before: Hwei's L1 painting poke out-ranges you and punishes your last-hitting before you have Death Ray.
edits.after: Hwei's L1 painting poke out-ranges you and punishes your last-hitting before you have Hextech Ray.

edits.before: Once you have E (Death Ray) you can finally trade back, sweeping the laser through his caster minions and clipping him when he steps up to last-hit. Bank Q (Siphon Power) shields before you commit so his QQ (Fleeting Current) chip doesn't stack on you uncontested.
edits.after: Once you have E (Hextech Ray) you can finally trade back, sweeping the laser through his caster minions and clipping him when he steps up to last-hit. Bank Q (Siphon Power) shields before you commit so his QQ (Devastating Fire) chip doesn't stack on you uncontested.

edits.before: Your R (Chaos Storm) matches his ult tempo but this stays even: he can EE (Stirring Lands) root-zone your storm approach and QW (Severing Bolt) execute if you dive low. Use R to zone a wave or peel a gank, not to force a solo kill you haven't set up.
edits.after: Your R (Arcane Storm) matches his ult tempo but this stays even: he can EW (Gaze of the Abyss) root your storm approach and QW (Severing Bolt) execute if you dive low. Use R to zone a wave or peel a gank, not to force a solo kill you haven't set up.

edits.before: By lvl 3 you stabilize with Death Ray for waveclear and safe trades, and lvls 4-6 are a skill fight: whoever respects the other's cooldowns wins. His EE root and QW execute keep your R honest, so use the storm to zone and peel rather than to force.
edits.after: By lvl 3 you stabilize with Hextech Ray for waveclear and safe trades, and lvls 4-6 are a skill fight: whoever respects the other's cooldowns wins. His Gaze of the Abyss root and QW execute keep your R honest, so use the storm to zone and peel, not force.

edits.before: Land QQ (Severing Bolt) resets on you at lvls 1-2 before you have E
edits.after: Land QW (Severing Bolt) snipes on you at lvls 1-2 before you have E

edits.before: Zone you off CS with EQ (Devastating Fire) and EE lands
edits.after: Zone you off CS with QQ (Devastating Fire) and QE lava
